parameters.content:
## Legend Sleep — Forecast Builder

A real product picker, served by n8n itself.

**Open** the `Open Page` node, copy its **Production URL**, and visit it in a
browser. That is the whole app.

```
https://<host>/webhook/legend-forecast
```

**No setup.** No env vars, no restart, no files on the server. The Code nodes are
pure JavaScript with zero `require()` calls.

**Why a served page and not an n8n Form:** form fields are static, and
`prepareFormFields` runs `sanitizeHtml()` so a Custom HTML field cannot carry any
script. There is no way to get search, 726 browsable products or a live preview
out of the form UI. `RespondToWebhook` serves raw HTML, so it can.

**Flow**

| Route | Does |
|---|---|
| `GET /webhook/legend-forecast` | serves the app |
| `POST` · `action=catalog` | reads the uploaded workbook, returns its 726 products |
| `POST` · `action=build` | writes the forecast, returns the .xlsx |

Both POST replies are binary so one Respond node covers them — Content-Type comes
from each binary's mimeType.

**The product list is read from the workbook you upload**, never hardcoded. So it
tracks your Pricelist automatically, and no pricing data lives in this repo.

**Weekly split** — the sheet's own curve: 24 / 15 / 11 / 20 / 30 %. Type a monthly
quantity and it splits automatically; expand a row to set weeks by hand.
